levels.name: Easy
summary: Fewer enemies in most fights: about 75% of the Medium XP budget.
Enemies rarely keep attacking a hero who is down.
Downed heroes get back up with 1 HP after a won fight.

levels.name: Medium
summary: Each main-story fight is Medium for your expected level (2014 DMG budgets).
Side quests put you about a level ahead, so main fights feel easier.
Standard 5e rules: short rest 1 hour, long rest 8 hours (once a day).

levels.name: Hard
summary: Extra enemies: about 150% of the Medium XP budget.
Smarter enemies: focus fire, flanking, targeted spells.
Enemies use reactions and go after your healers.
